mes-scribe-11.see: A stone-paved chamber enclosed by painted wall panels with maize motifs, containing a central low desk covered in paper sheets, two rope-tied wicker chests, and a doorway hung with a striped textile curtain.
mes-scribe-11.focal: The central low desk covered in paper documents and scrolls
mes-scribe-11.wrong: The wicker chest on the right clips into the partition wall; document text is unreadable blurry texture; bottom half of the frame is an empty black grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.

mes-shrine-11.see: A stone-floored room with painted maize-pattern wall panels featuring a central banquet table laden with food, flanked by two tall ceramic braziers, and fronted by a reclining Chacmool figure on a woven mat.
mes-shrine-11.culture: Pre-Columbian Mesoamerican (Aztec / Toltec / Maya), Postclassic period
mes-shrine-11.focal: The food-laden stone altar table flanked by two tall braziers
mes-shrine-11.wrong: The stone Chacmool statue is placed on a woven mat directly in front of the table facing away toward the doorway; bottom half of the frame is an unrendered dark grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.

mes-chinampa-11.see: An upper stone chamber with a wooden throne chair and wicker chests that opens through a curtained doorway past three cypress trees directly onto a large pool of water holding two raised garden beds.
mes-chinampa-11.culture: Pre-Columbian Mesoamerican (Aztec / Mexica chinampa style), Postclassic period
mes-chinampa-11.focal: The large water pool containing raised chinampa-style crop beds
mes-chinampa-11.wrong: Three cypress trees grow directly out of open water with no visible planters or ground; the garden beds float in open water with no walkway or anchorage; the doorway curtain leads directly into water with no steps; bottom half is an empty dark grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.

mes-house-11.see: A wide stone-floored room enclosed by maize-painted wall panels, containing a central high-backed wooden armchair flanked by two rope-bound wicker chests on a woven mat.
mes-house-11.focal: The high-backed wooden throne flanked by two wicker chests
mes-house-11.wrong: A woven mat and object on the far left are cut off at the edge; room is sparse with large empty floor areas; bottom half is an unrendered black grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.

mes-market-11.see: A stone throne alcove leading through a curtained entrance into a dirt-floored open area lined with two parallel rows of vendor mats holding pottery, produce, and textiles among patches of straw.
mes-market-11.culture: Pre-Columbian Mesoamerican (Aztec / Mexica tianguis market), Postclassic period
mes-market-11.focal: The dual parallel rows of merchandise display mats arranged across the dirt floor
mes-market-11.wrong: Straw piles and dark mud patches appear as completely flat 2D decals pasted over the dirt floor; merchandise mats are rigidly aligned but devoid of any merchants or figures; bottom half terminates in empty black grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.

mes-ballcourt-11.see: An elevated stone chamber with a wooden throne, side table, and grinding stone overlooking an adjoining dirt hall furnished with long wooden benches and straw piles.
mes-ballcourt-11.focal: The inward-facing perimeter benches framing the lower dirt hall
mes-ballcourt-11.wrong: A giant bright-green arrow/mesh icon is clipping in from the upper-left corner; flat straw and puddle decals on the dirt floor; upper-right bench is positioned directly against a corner partition; bottom half is an empty dark grid void; top-left debug HUD overlay.
